name: TranslationResult
description: A private per-segment translation result linked to one transcription session and AudioSegment, with bounded source-positioned translated line snapshots

source_segment_id.description: AudioSegment id whose generated transcript lines were translated

status.description: Translation lifecycle status: translating, completed, or failed

requested_source_language.description: Requested source language code, or auto when the source language should be detected

detected_source_language.description: Safe detected source language code returned by the later translation workflow

target_language.description: Requested target language code; auto is never valid here

source_hash.description: Bounded integrity hash for the source lines used by this result

settings_hash.description: Bounded hash for the translation settings used by this result

lines.description: Bounded translated line snapshots preserving source ids, order, text, speaker labels, and source timing

kind.description: Original line kind: speech, marker, or timestamp

source_text.description: Bounded original line text at translation time

speaker_label.description: Speaker label copied from the source line when present

provider_speaker_id.description: Provider speaker identity copied from the source line when present

start_ms.description: Source-relative line start time in milliseconds when present

end_ms.description: Source-relative line end time in milliseconds when present

error.description: Safe bounded error message for staff; never raw provider output or secrets

retry.description: Number of translation retries for this source segment

translation_started_at.description: ISO timestamp when the latest translation attempt began

translated_at.description: ISO timestamp when the latest translation completed

failed_at.description: ISO timestamp when the latest translation attempt failed

audio_status.description: Independent translated-audio lifecycle status: idle, synthesizing, completed, or failed

audio_url.description: Managed storage URL for the saved translated voice clip

audio_mime_type.description: MIME type of the saved translated voice clip

audio_voice_id.description: Provider voice identifier used for the saved clip, when safe to retain

audio_error.description: Safe bounded translated-audio error that does not replace translated text

audio_generated_at.description: ISO timestamp when the translated voice clip was saved
